body.head: Changes from TEI P4 to TEI P5 which concerns Menota
body.p: TEI P5 1.0 published was published November 2, 2007.

div.head: Changes in the XML Document Prologue
div.p: The document type declaration (DTD) had to be changed from the P4 to the P5 version of the Menota schema because entity list are not a legal part of the TEI schemas for P5. In Menota, the entities are important and numerous, and when using P5, a separate file with the entities has to be made and included into all XML documents which need them. The various schema languages does not have support for entities, only DTD has, so all documents using the Menota encoding will have to refer to a DTD, where the entities have been included, as shown in Appendix D.3: Referring to the Menota schema.

div.head: Root element
div.p: The root element has been changed from TEI.2 to TEI

div.head: resp in sic
div.p: The attribute resp in the element sic has been removed in P5. It was probably an error to have it declared in P4. Example 22 in chapter 7 of the Menota Handbook used it. This example has been removed from version 2.0 of the handbook.

The content model of change in revisionDesc is changed, the element respStmd is removed, and the content is more narrative. An example may look like this:
<change>On <date value="2006-02-02">2 February 2006</date>, <name>Tone Merete Bruvik</name> edited the file according to the TEI P5 0.3.1 published on 30 January 2006. </change>

div.head: langKey changed into mainLang
div.p: The attribute langKey in textLang has been changed into mainLang: <textLang langKey="oic">Old Icelandic</textLang> -> <textLang mainLang="oic">Old Icelandic</textLang></change>

div.head: Encoding of hands
div.p: handList has been replaced with handNotes
hand has been replaced with handNote

div.head: Attribute changes
div.p: The element date has an attribute when, which in P4 was called value

div.head: Changes from MASTER to P5
div.p: Menota v. 1.1 contained the recommendations from the MASTER project. TEI P5 includes the recommendations from the TEI Manuscript Description Taskforce. Although the recommendations from TEI Manuscript Description Task are based on the MASTER recommendations, there are some differences which Menota has to handle.

div.head: msHeading has been removed
div.p: The element msHeading is not in P5, and the content of this element has to be encoded otherwise.

div.head: msWriting is removed
div.p: The elementet msWriting has been removed, handDescshould be used in its place.
Encoding in MASTER:

p.egXML: The main hand (Hand 1) writes ff. 1r-9r and 16r-118v in a practised Gothic hybrid.

div.p: Encoding in P5:

p.egXML: The main hand (Hand 1) writes ff. 1r-9r and 16r-118v in a practised Gothic hybrid.

div.head: Encoding of roles
div.p: In MASTER, the attribute role in the name element was used to encode the role of the person whose name was stated in the element. This attribute is not available in P5, so the Menota project had to decide how this should be encoded. This example is given in '10.6 The history of the manuscript':

p.egXML: According to AM 435 a 4to, ff. 54v-56v, the manuscript had been owned by Sr. Þórður Jónsson á Staðastað (1672-1720), who had got it from Jón Hákonarson að Vatnshorni ...

div.p: We suggest that subtype is used to replace role in this case.

div.head: Changes in sourceDesc
div.p: It is not longer valid to have both p and msDescription as child elements of sourceDesc. A p element should be moved into a summary element like this (sample from AM 233 a fol): <sourceDesc> <msDescription> <msIdentifier> <country key="DK">Denmark</country> <settlement>Copenhagen</settlement> <repository>The Arnamagnæan Institute</repository> <idno>AM 233 a fol</idno> </msIdentifier> <msContents> <summary>The source is an anonymous translation from Latin into Old Norse made in the second half of the 12th century, possibly in Norway. The original is lost and the text is only preserved in younger Icelandic manuscripts, including the two fragments in AM 233 a fol, fol. 28rA (the first column on the recto page) and 28vB (the second column on the verso page). This fragment is dated to 1350-1360 in "Ordbog over det norrøne prosasprog" (Index volume).</summary> ...

div.head: Minor changes
div.p: msDescription has been changed into msDesc

div.head: Attribute values
div.p: The value of the attribute defective in msItem should have the values 'true' or 'false', not 'yes' or 'no'. This applies to other Boolean attributes as well.
The attributes technique, figurative and illustrative in the decoNote element have been removed in P5.
The attribute reg in the country has been removed. Use for instance key.
